firstReadyToast: Your first Short is ready – the others follow as they are finished.
resultsSummary: {{ready}} ready to post, of {{made}} made · {{shorts}} Shorts · {{long}} long-form
degradedTitle: Not checked by the AI editor
degradedBody: No language-model key was available, so these clips were chosen by the basic engine and no clip is marked publish-ready. Add your Anthropic key in Settings → AI and regenerate for the full editor.
workingBody: Finished videos appear here as soon as each one passes the final review. You can close the browser – the work continues on the server.
noneReadyBody: The editor rejected every candidate rather than give you weak clips. See the other candidates below, or try a different source.
otherOutputsHint: These were made but did not pass every final check (editor, render check or subtitle timing). They are not recommended for posting as they are.
otherCandidates: Other candidates the editor turned down ({{count}})
otherCandidatesHint: Moments that were considered and rejected, with the reason. Shown for transparency – they were not rendered.
caption: Caption idea:
diagnostics: Diagnostics – how the clips were chosen

reason.not_verified_by_editor: not checked by the AI editor
reason.uncertain_critical_word: an uncertain name or number in the subtitles
reason.near_pass: closest call – did not pass every check

goal.label: What should Polixor make?
goal.manual: Let me configure it after the analysis
goal.packageHint: The best moments as Shorts, and a focused long-form video per strong topic.
goal.shortHint: Only the moments good enough to post as vertical Shorts.
goal.longformHint: Focused long-form videos of the strongest topics.
goal.manualHint: Polixor analyses the video and waits for you to choose the settings.

profileHint: Changes what the editor looks for. Detected automatically by default.

quality.premiumHint: Strong speech recognition on the whole source and a verified final transcript for every clip. Slower.
quality.fastHint: Lighter speech recognition for finding moments. The editor and the final checks still run.

clipCountHint: A maximum, not a quota – Polixor returns fewer if fewer are good.
overlayHint: Off by default: a Short is the video and its subtitles. Turn on to burn a short hook line into the first seconds.
startHint: Polixor analyses the video and then edits it by itself. You can close the browser and come back later.
noEditorBody: Without a language-model key nothing is checked by the editor, so nothing is marked ready to post. The clips that were made are below.

upload.network: The connection to the server dropped.
upload.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
upload.chunkFailed: A part of the file was refused by the server (HTTP {{status}}).
upload.failedHint: Everything already sent is kept on the server – press Retry to continue from there.
upload.pendingBody: {{name}} ({{size}}) – choose the same file again to continue where it stopped.
upload.proxyRefuses: The connection refuses even small parts of the file.
upload.proxyRefusesHint: Try another network or contact support with the reference.
upload.startsWhenUploaded: The project starts by itself when the upload is done – you can keep using Polixor meanwhile (keep this tab open).
upload.startWhenUploaded: Start when the upload is done
upload.projectStartsAfter: The project starts when the upload is done

diag.title: Diagnostics – what the editor decided and where the time went

verdict.shipped: The editor shipped clips from this source
verdict.editor_unavailable: The editor could not judge these candidates – nothing was rejected for quality
verdict.repairable_moments_rejected: Real moments were found but failed on how they were cut
verdict.no_publishable_moments: The candidates were judged weak moments

diag.counts: {{candidates}} candidates · {{judged}} judged by the editor · {{shipped}} shipped · {{repaired}} repaired · {{rejected}} rejected ({{near}} near-pass) · {{unev}} not evaluated
diag.retryStarted: Generating again – cached analysis is reused
diag.milestones: First Short after {{first}} · all Shorts after {{all}} · long-form after {{long}} (from the start of generation)
diag.model: Model calls: {{calls}} made, {{cached}} from cache ({{hit}}%), {{failures}} failed
diag.processes: Processes: {{procs}} started, {{decodes}} full decodes of the source

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.body: Processing continues from the last saved point. Everything already finished is kept, and you are not charged again.

usage.title: Your plan
usage.note: Only the minutes of your source videos count. Editing, re-exporting and downloads never do.
usage.none: No videos processed in this period yet.

quota.over: You have {{remaining}} minutes remaining. This video is {{video}} minutes.
quota.overHint: Choose a shorter part, wait for the next period, or upgrade your plan.
